text:
Prompt optimization isn't language agnostic.

My self-improving agent treats English as a logic gate and Spanish as a context layer.

El razonamiento bilingüe no es solo traducción.

Most builders fail the 600M Spanish market because they ignore the nuance.

Are you optimizing or just translating?

#AIEngineering #LLMs #BilingualAI
idea_source: How I built a self-improving AI agent that evolves its own prompts
